# Paths & colour palettes

```{r setup}
rna.combined <- readRDS("Z:/dmclab/Marta/PD/Combined_snRNAseq/data/rna.combined.subclusters_res1.5_annotated_allen_1122.rds")
indir        <- "Z:/dmclab/Marta/PD/Combined_snRNAseq/subclustering/new_allen_analysis/Revision/hwcgna_samplegroups"
dir.create(indir, showWarnings = FALSE)
set.seed(12345)

# Sample-group colours used in panels G–J
sg_colors <- c(
  "Control"       = "#858585",
  "6OHDA"         = "#84484aff",
  "Mitopark_11"   = "#d8b0b2ff",
  "Mitopark15_18" = "#be7b7eff"
)

# Module → WGCNA colour mapping
module_color_map <- data.frame(
  module = c("Module_1","Module_2","Module_3","Module_4",
             "Module_5","Module_6","Module_7","Module_8"),
  color  = c("yellow","turquoise","brown","red",
             "blue","green","black","pink"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

pairwise_comparisons <- list(
  c("Control","6OHDA"),
  c("Control","Mitopark_11"),
  c("Control","Mitopark15_18")
)
```

# ── hdWGCNA PIPELINE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Subset & clean object

```{r subset}
rna.combined <- subset(
  x      = rna.combined,
  idents = setdiff(unique(Idents(rna.combined)), "Splatter")
)

# Remove UMAP outlier region
umap_data     <- Embeddings(rna.combined, reduction = "umap_after_harmony_3")
cells_to_keep <- !(umap_data[,1] >= -9 & umap_data[,1] <= -3 &
                   umap_data[,2] >= -14 & umap_data[,2] <= -3)
rna.combined  <- subset(rna.combined, cells = colnames(rna.combined)[cells_to_keep])
rna.combined$clusters <- Idents(rna.combined)
```

## SetupForWGCNA → Metacells → Normalize

```{r setup_wgcna}
rna.combined <- SetupForWGCNA(
  rna.combined,
  gene_select = "fraction",
  fraction    = 0.05,
  wgcna_name  = "wgcna_1"
)

rna.combined <- MetacellsByGroups(
  seurat_obj  = rna.combined,
  group.by    = c("clusters","Sample_group"),
  reduction   = "umap_after_harmony_3",
  k           = 20,
  max_shared  = 10,
  ident.group = "Sample_group"
)

rna.combined <- NormalizeMetacells(rna.combined)
```

## SetDatExpr → TestSoftPowers → ConstructNetwork

```{r network}
valid_groups <- as.character(rna.combined$Sample_group)

rna.combined <- SetDatExpr(
  rna.combined,
  group_name = valid_groups,
  group.by   = "Sample_group",
  assay      = "RNA",
  layer      = "data"
)

rna.combined <- TestSoftPowers(rna.combined, networkType = "signed")

rna.combined <- ConstructNetwork(
  rna.combined,
  soft_power    = 9,
  tom_name      = "SPNs_sg",
  overwrite_tom = TRUE
)
```

## ScaleData → ModuleEigengenes → ModuleConnectivity → ResetModuleNames

```{r eigengenes}
rna.combined <- ScaleData(rna.combined, features = VariableFeatures(rna.combined))

rna.combined <- ModuleEigengenes(rna.combined)

rna.combined <- ModuleConnectivity(rna.combined)

rna.combined <- ResetModuleNames(rna.combined, new_name = "Module_")
```

## ModuleExprScore (UCell)

```{r ucell}
rna.combined <- ModuleExprScore(rna.combined, n_genes = 25, method = "UCell")
```

## Retrieve hMEs & build long-format table

```{r hmes}
hMEs <- GetMEs(rna.combined)
hMEs$Sample_group <- rna.combined$Sample_group

hMEs_long <- pivot_longer(
  hMEs,
  cols      = -Sample_group,
  names_to  = "Module",
  values_to = "Eigengene"
)
```

## ANOVA – identify significant modules

```{r anova_sig_modules}
module_stats <- hMEs_long %>%
  group_by(Module) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = summary(aov(Eigengene ~ Sample_group))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
  ) %>%
  mutate(adj_p = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(adj_p)

sig_modules <- module_stats %>% filter(adj_p < 0.05) %>% pull(Module)

hMEs_sig <- hMEs_long %>%
  filter(Module %in% sig_modules) %>%
  left_join(module_color_map, by = c("Module" = "module"))
```

## Build raw-eigengene summary per module × cluster × condition

```{r raw_summary}
# Add hMEs to metadata
hmes_numeric <- hMEs[, sapply(hMEs, is.numeric)]
rna.combined  <- AddMetaData(rna.combined, metadata = hmes_numeric)

hMEs_raw <- hMEs %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(module_color_map$module)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_id")

cell_info <- rna.combined@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(clusters, Sample_group) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_id")

summary_raw_barplot <- hMEs_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cell_id, names_to = "Module", values_to = "Value") %>%
  left_join(cell_info, by = "cell_id") %>%
  filter(!grepl("grey", Module)) %>%
  group_by(Module, clusters, Sample_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_Raw = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

## Build delta metrics + ANOVA / Welch T-test statistics (Mitopark transitions)

```{r delta_stats_mitopark}
master_module_metrics <- summary_raw_barplot %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample_group, values_from = mean_Raw, names_prefix = "Group_") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Group_"), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_Early = Group_Mitopark_11   - Group_Control,
    Delta_Late  = Group_Mitopark15_18 - Group_Mitopark_11,
    delta_total = Group_Mitopark15_18 - Group_Control,
    Delta_6OHDA = Group_6OHDA         - Group_Control
  )

get_comprehensive_stats <- function(mod, clus) {
  cell_names <- colnames(rna.combined)[rna.combined$clusters == clus]
  if (length(cell_names) < 10)
    return(data.frame(P_ANOVA = NA, P_Early = NA, P_Late = NA, P_Total = NA))

  test_data <- data.frame(
    val = hMEs[cell_names, mod],
    grp = factor(rna.combined$Sample_group[cell_names],
                 levels = c("Control","Mitopark_11","Mitopark15_18"))
  )
  anova_res <- aov(val ~ grp, data = test_data)
  p_anova   <- summary(anova_res)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]

  safe_t <- function(g1, g2) {
    sub <- test_data %>% filter(grp %in% c(g1, g2))
    if (length(unique(sub$grp)) < 2) return(NA)
    t.test(val ~ grp, data = sub)$p.value
  }
  data.frame(
    P_ANOVA = p_anova,
    P_Early = safe_t("Control","Mitopark_11"),
    P_Late  = safe_t("Mitopark_11","Mitopark15_18"),
    P_Total = safe_t("Control","Mitopark15_18")
  )
}

master_sig_mitopark <- master_module_metrics %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(stats = list(get_comprehensive_stats(Module, clusters))) %>%
  unnest(stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("P_"), ~p.adjust(., method = "BH"), .names = "{.col}_adj")) %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_adj"),
                ~case_when(. < 0.001 ~ "***", . < 0.01 ~ "**", . < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ " "),
                .names = "{.col}_sig"))
```

## 6-OHDA T-test significance (Disease vs Control, BH corrected)

```{r delta_stats_6ohda}
rna.combined$Condition <- ifelse(rna.combined$Sample_group == "Control", "Control", "Disease")

get_sig_v2 <- function(mod, clus) {
  cell_names <- colnames(rna.combined)[rna.combined$clusters == clus]
  if (length(cell_names) < 3) return(NA)
  vals <- hMEs[cell_names, mod]
  grps <- rna.combined$Condition[cell_names]
  if (length(unique(grps)) < 2) return(NA)
  t.test(vals ~ grps)$p.value
}

master_6oda_sig <- summary_raw_barplot %>%
  filter(Sample_group %in% c("Control","6OHDA")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample_group, values_from = mean_Raw, names_prefix = "Group_") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Group_"), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(delta_total = Group_6OHDA - Group_Control) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p_val = get_sig_v2(Module, clusters)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH")) %>%
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**", p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ " "
  ))
```

## Compute intra-module pairwise gene–gene correlations per group

```{r intramodule_corr}
modules_df   <- GetModules(rna.combined) %>% filter(module != "grey")
modules_list <- unique(modules_df$module)
groups       <- unique(rna.combined$Sample_group)

corr_values <- data.frame()

for (mod in modules_list) {
  mod_genes <- modules_df %>% filter(module == mod) %>% pull(gene_name)

  for (grp in groups) {
    cells    <- WhichCells(rna.combined, expression = Sample_group == grp)
    expr_mat <- GetAssayData(rna.combined, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")[mod_genes, cells, drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(expr_mat) < 3 || ncol(expr_mat) < 10) next

    # Remove zero-variance genes before correlating
    expr_mat <- expr_mat[apply(expr_mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(expr_mat) < 3) next

    cor_mat  <- cor(t(as.matrix(expr_mat)), method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    cor_vals <- abs(cor_mat[lower.tri(cor_mat)])
    corr_values <- rbind(corr_values,
                         data.frame(module = mod, group = grp, correlation = cor_vals))
  }
}

corr_values <- corr_values %>%
  left_join(module_color_map, by = c("module" = "module"))
```

## FindDMEs (each model vs Control)

```{r dme}
target_groups    <- c("6OHDA","Mitopark_11","Mitopark15_18")
control_barcodes <- rownames(subset(rna.combined@meta.data, Sample_group == "Control"))

dme_list <- list()
for (group in target_groups) {
  exp_barcodes <- rownames(subset(rna.combined@meta.data, Sample_group == group))
  res <- FindDMEs(
    rna.combined,
    barcodes1  = exp_barcodes,
    barcodes2  = control_barcodes,
    test.use   = "wilcox",
    harmonized = TRUE,
    wgcna_name = "wgcna_1"
  )
  res$Comparison <- paste0(group, "_vs_Control")
  res$Module     <- rownames(res)
  dme_list[[group]] <- res
}

all_dme_results <- do.call(rbind, dme_list)
```

# ── FIGURE 3G – Module eigengene UMAPs ────────────────────────────────────────

```{r fig3G}
p_list <- ModuleFeaturePlot(
  rna.combined,
  reduction = "umap_after_harmony_3",
  features  = "hMEs",
  order     = TRUE
)

n_cols     <- 3
n_rows     <- ceiling(length(p_list) / n_cols)
panel_size <- 4

for (i in seq_along(p_list)) {
  p_list[[i]] <- p_list[[i]] +
    scale_colour_gradient2(
      low      = "#e08214ff",
      mid      = "gray",
      high     = "#592664ff",
      midpoint = 0,
      na.value = "grey80"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      aspect.ratio    = 1
    )
}

fig3G <- wrap_plots(p_list, ncol = n_cols)

ggsave(
  filename  = file.path(indir, "Fig3G_Module_FeaturePlots.pdf"),
  plot      = fig3G,
  width     = n_cols * panel_size + 2,
  height    = n_rows * panel_size,
  limitsize = FALSE
)
```

# ── FIGURE 3H – Module dot plot (load per condition) ─────────────────────────

```{r fig3H}
p3H <- ggplot(
  summary_raw_barplot %>%
    group_by(Module, Sample_group) %>%
    summarise(mean_Raw = mean(mean_Raw, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
  aes(x = Sample_group, y = Module, color = mean_Raw, size = abs(mean_Raw))
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#31869bff", mid = "gray", high = "#963634ff", midpoint = 0
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 8)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Module Eigengene Load per Sample Group",
    x     = "Sample Group",
    y     = "Module",
    color = "Mean Eigengene",
    size  = "|Mean Eigengene|"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

pdf(file.path(indir, "Fig3H_Module_Dotplot.pdf"), width = 6, height = 5)
print(p3H)
dev.off()
```

# ── FIGURE 3I – Cumulative load bar chart ─────────────────────────────────────

```{r fig3I}
cluster_load_summary <- master_sig_mitopark %>%
  left_join(
    master_6oda_sig %>% dplyr::select(Module, clusters, Delta_6OHDA = delta_total),
    by = c("Module","clusters")
  ) %>%
  group_by(clusters) %>%
  summarise(
    `Ctrl->11w`    = sum(abs(Delta_Early),  na.rm = TRUE),
    `11w->18w`     = sum(abs(Delta_Late),   na.rm = TRUE),
    `Mitopark Tot` = sum(abs(delta_total),  na.rm = TRUE),
    `6-OHDA`       = sum(abs(Delta_6OHDA),  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -clusters, names_to = "Transition", values_to = "Cumulative_Load")

p3I <- ggplot(
  cluster_load_summary,
  aes(x = reorder(clusters, -Cumulative_Load), y = Cumulative_Load, fill = Transition)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Ctrl->11w"    = "#d8b0b2ff",
    "11w->18w"     = "#84484aff",
    "Mitopark Tot" = "#5e2f31",
    "6-OHDA"       = "#be7b7eff"
  )) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Transcriptomic Load per Cluster",
    x     = "Cell Cluster",
    y     = "Cumulative |Δ Eigengene|",
    fill  = "Transition"
  )

pdf(file.path(indir, "Fig3I_Cumulative_Load_Clusters.pdf"), width = 10, height = 5)
print(p3I)
dev.off()
```

# ── FIGURE 3J – Violin: avg eigengene + intra-module correlation ──────────────

```{r fig3J}
# One combined PDF per significant module
for (mod in sig_modules) {
  module_color <- module_color_map$color[module_color_map$module == mod]

  # Left: avg eigengene violin with Wilcoxon pairwise comparisons
  hme_plot <- hMEs_sig %>%
    filter(Module == mod) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Sample_group, y = Eigengene, fill = Sample_group)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.8, color = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = "median", geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 5, color = "black") +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = pairwise_comparisons, method = "wilcox.test") +
    facet_wrap(~Module, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sg_colors) +
    ylim(0, 50) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    labs(
      title = paste(mod, "–", module_color),
      y     = "Avg eigengene",
      x     = "Sample Group"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

  # Right: intra-module gene–gene correlation violin with Wilcoxon pairwise comparisons
  corr_plot <- corr_values %>%
    filter(module == mod) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = group, y = correlation, fill = group)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", alpha = 1) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = pairwise_comparisons,
      method      = "wilcox.test",
      label       = "p.signif"
    ) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sg_colors) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Intra-Module Correlation:", mod),
      x     = "Sample Group",
      y     = "Correlation"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  combined <- hme_plot + corr_plot + plot_layout(ncol = 2)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(indir, paste0("Fig3J_", mod, "_eigengene_and_correlation.pdf")),
    plot     = combined,
    width    = 11,
    height   = 5
  )
}
```
